global_metric: Native top-level confidence JSON iptm; no ps_iptm, pair ipTM, pTM or confidence_score substitution
previous_atoms: MVAP chain L O16; ATP chain T PG; beta-gamma bridge chain T O3B; vertex PG
RFD4_atoms: MVAP IMV O16; ATP IAT P41; beta-gamma bridge IAT O27; vertex P41

selection_policy.objective: Higher cellular isoprenol titer in a matched host and pathway context
selection_policy.selection_type: Final expert-adjudicated experimental proposal from existing evidence; not a fitted optimum or predicted titer ranking
selection_policy.primary: ESMFold2 MVAP-only native global ipTM; retain magnitude, paired 10-seed interval and within-enzyme rank. No universal positive-delta gate.
selection_policy.secondary: Boltz full-complex native global ipTM; explicit corroboration/disagreement. Approximate conditional intervals from 50 diffusion samples under one parent seed are not seed-robust or biological intervals.
selection_policy.NAC: Annotation only; no gain requirement, ranking weight, or automatic veto.
selection_policy.contacts: Mechanistic hypotheses and concrete risk review; no required contact gain and no independent vote counting.
selection_policy.conservation: Natural occurrences support tolerance. Broad property loss is a risk annotation; Ha I112D is an explicit reviewed exception. Catalytic-core positions remain protected.
selection_policy.risk_review: Use recurrent gross clashes, noncomplementary packing, stereochemistry and specific lost contacts to defer risky candidates. Existing geometric frequency thresholds are heuristic, not experimentally calibrated.
selection_policy.allocation: User approved a panel of 20 specific mutants: retain 9 priority and 4 higher-risk candidates, and add 7 supported screening hypotheses (5 At, 2 Ha). All seven have positive primary intervals and pass the historical chemistry/structural holds; unresolved or negative secondary mean evidence is disclosed. No padding to the available capacity of 32.
selection_policy.ranking: Export the 9 priority, 4 higher-risk and 7 additional groups in that order; within each group sort by enzyme and descending primary mean. Overlapping intervals do not establish pairwise superiority. Groups reflect documented expert judgments.

scope.review_priority: Union of top 25 non-core means and lower confidence bounds per enzyme, plus previous shortlisted and audited alternatives.

limitations: Same-study MDDsc calibration does not establish transfer to At/Ha.
Fresh MSAs, runtime and sampling settings differ across campaigns.
No predicted fold-change or calibrated hit probability.
Contact and NAC annotations share coordinates.
Negative evidence is disclosed; unresolved is not equivalent to safe.
RFD4 inputs are coordinate-conditioned generated structures, not Boltz-2 cofold predictions.
The panel primary metric was ESMFold2 MVAP-only global ipTM; Boltz full-complex global ipTM was secondary.
Pose spread is conditional on saved campaign sampling; no fresh independent-seed confirmation.
